import { writeFileSync, mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { it } from "vitest";
import {
  applyPresetPlan, applySelection, compilePrompt, createEmptySpec, createMemoryStore, createSpecStorage, exportSpecJson,
  getCoreRegistry, planPreset, WORKSPACE_STORAGE_KEY, type ImageSpec, type SelectionValue,
} from "@/domain";
import { CatalogRegistry } from "@/domain";
import { buildFixtureCatalog } from "@/testing/fixtureCatalog";

const OUT = process.env.CAPTURE_OUT!;
const set = (spec: ImageSpec, reg: CatalogRegistry, id: string, v: SelectionValue) => {
  const r = applySelection(spec, reg, id, v);
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(id + JSON.stringify(r.diagnostics));
  return r.value;
};
it("capture Sprint 2-A fixtures", () => {
  mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
  const core = getCoreRegistry();
  // 1) Core: every approved Detailed attribute (Basic + 6 lighting properties) incl. a preset-unit takeover context
  let s = createEmptySpec(core);
  const vals: Array<[string, SelectionValue]> = [
    ["intent.description", { kind: "text", text: "A violinist rehearsing on an empty stage" }],
    ["subject.kind", { kind: "single", optionId: "person" }],
    ["style.preset", { kind: "single", optionId: "cinematic_still" }],
    ["composition.framing", { kind: "single", optionId: "upper_body" }],
    ["composition.view_direction", { kind: "single", optionId: "three_quarter" }],
    ["camera.angle", { kind: "single", optionId: "low_angle" }],
    ["scene.setting", { kind: "single", optionId: "nature" }],
    ["scene.background", { kind: "single", optionId: "blurred" }],
    ["mood.tone", { kind: "multi", optionIds: ["calm", "dramatic"] }],
    ["lighting.preset", { kind: "single", optionId: "golden_hour" }],
    ["lighting.source", { kind: "single", optionId: "sun" }],
    ["lighting.direction", { kind: "single", optionId: "side" }],
    ["lighting.softness", { kind: "single", optionId: "soft" }],
    ["lighting.intensity", { kind: "single", optionId: "moderate" }],
    ["lighting.color_temperature", { kind: "single", optionId: "cool" }],
    ["lighting.contrast", { kind: "single", optionId: "high" }],
    ["output.aspect_ratio", { kind: "single", optionId: "landscape_16_9" }],
  ];
  const skipped: string[] = [];
  for (const [id, v] of vals) {
    const r = applySelection(s, core, id, v);
    if (r.ok) s = r.value; else skipped.push(id);
  }
  // 2) Fixture catalog spec with preset provenance (origin), produced by the real preset flow
  const fx = CatalogRegistry.createOrThrow(buildFixtureCatalog());
  let f = createEmptySpec(fx);
  f = set(f, fx, "subject.kind", { kind: "single", optionId: "person" });
  const presetId = fx.presets[0]!.id;
  const plan = planPreset(f, fx, presetId);
  if (!plan.ok) throw new Error("plan");
  f = applyPresetPlan(f, fx, plan.value, "all").spec;
  const store = createMemoryStore();
  createSpecStorage(store, core).save(s, new Date("2026-11-24T00:00:00Z"));
  writeFileSync(join(OUT, "export-core-detailed.json"), exportSpecJson(s));
  writeFileSync(join(OUT, "export-fixture-preset.json"), exportSpecJson(f));
  writeFileSync(join(OUT, "localstorage-workspace.txt"), store.getItem(WORKSPACE_STORAGE_KEY)!);
  const cc = compilePrompt(s, core);
  const fc = compilePrompt(f, fx);
  writeFileSync(join(OUT, "expected-prompts.json"), JSON.stringify({
    "export-core-detailed.json": { prompt: cc.prompt, parameters: cc.parameters, blocked: cc.blocked, fragments: cc.fragments, meta: cc.meta },
    "export-fixture-preset.json": { presetId, prompt: fc.prompt, blocked: fc.blocked, fragments: fc.fragments, meta: fc.meta },
    skippedInvalidSamples: skipped,
  }, null, 2) + "\n");
});
